scientific_integrity: The coefficient extraction, arithmetic factorization and Frobenius-rank argument are transparent and supported by two runnable exact-arithmetic programs. Mathematical inputs from published papers are acknowledged; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: This is a complete coefficient-parameter classification for one specified smooth genus-four pencil in characteristic 19, not a classification of geometric isomorphism classes or full Newton polygons. Residual priority risk for older equivalent parameterizations remains.
title: Eight rank-one Hasse–Witt fibers in a genus-four bielliptic pencil over \(\overline{\mathbb F}_{19}\)
